purpose: Defines common watch item triggers for weekly cash-flow review.

watch_item_triggers.why_it_matters: Net activity does not confirm actual cash available.
watch_item_triggers.suggested_action: Ask for opening and ending balances or current cash balance.

watch_item_triggers.why_it_matters: Outflows exceeded inflows during the review period.
watch_item_triggers.suggested_action: Review upcoming obligations and expected receivables.

watch_item_triggers.why_it_matters: One-time or unusual expenses can distort cash position.
watch_item_triggers.suggested_action: Confirm whether the payment was expected and whether similar payments are due soon.

watch_item_triggers.why_it_matters: One-time deposits may make the week look stronger than normal.
watch_item_triggers.suggested_action: Confirm whether the deposit is recurring or one-time.

watch_item_triggers.why_it_matters: Duplicates may overstate inflows or outflows.
watch_item_triggers.suggested_action: Flag possible duplicates for review instead of deleting them silently.

watch_item_triggers.why_it_matters: Transfers may be mistaken for revenue or expenses.
watch_item_triggers.suggested_action: Confirm whether the transaction is an internal transfer.

watch_item_triggers.why_it_matters: Debt service can create recurring cash-flow pressure.
watch_item_triggers.suggested_action: Track payment frequency and compare against weekly inflows.

watch_item_triggers.why_it_matters: Positive and negative signs may be interpreted differently across exports.
watch_item_triggers.suggested_action: Ask user to confirm whether amounts represent debits, credits, or signed net activity.

watch_item_triggers.why_it_matters: Small recurring tools can quietly stack into meaningful spend.
watch_item_triggers.suggested_action: Review subscriptions monthly and cancel unused tools.

watch_item_triggers.why_it_matters: A week may look healthy because of one or two large deposits.
watch_item_triggers.suggested_action: Confirm whether large deposits are recurring, delayed, or one-time.

rules: If data is incomplete, state that the risk level is based only on uploaded information.
A watch item is not a final diagnosis.
Recommendations should be operational next steps, not tax, legal, accounting, investment, lending, or underwriting advice.
